jobs.description:
**Job no:** 561957  

**Work type:** Staff  

**Location:** Long Beach  

**Categories:** Unit 4 \- APC \- Academic Professionals of California, Administrative, Full Time  

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!



Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322\-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.



As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.



Work\-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year\-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.



Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.



### **Job Summary**



This position is responsible for all academic support services and community engagement for designated state support and self\-support Master of Business Administration (MBA) programs and Master of Science (MS) graduate programs including, but not limited to, on\-line admission processes, academic counseling, probation counseling, and monitoring of academic progress to meet degree requirements. They work directly with applicants, matriculated graduate students, program alumni, Program Advisory Boards, College of Business Administration (CBA) faculty and other administrators, the Center for International Education, the Career Development Center, Enrollment Services, and the College of Professional \& Continuing Education (CPaCE).



### **Key Responsibilities**


* Graduate Admissions
* Advising graduate students
* Cohort administration
* Office administration \& Other duties as assigned

### **Department**



COB Graduate Programs Office



### **Time Base**



1\.0 time\-base, 40 hours per week.



### **Duration of Appointment**



This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.



### **Classification**



Student Services Professional III



### **Compensation**



Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.


* Hiring Range: The hiring range for this position is $5,540 \- $6,182 per month commensurate with candidate's education, experience, skills, and training.
* CSU Classification Salary Range: The CSU Classification Salary Range for this position is $5,540 \- $7,893 per month.

### **Benefits**



At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well\-being.



To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half\-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on appointment type, classification, and applicable collective bargaining agreement. Eligible employees may have access to a comprehensive benefits package that can include:


* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 24 vacation days per year (based on employee group and/or length of service), 14 paid holidays, and 12 sick days annually with unlimited accrual.
* **Health Coverage:** A variety of medical, dental, and vision plans.
* **Retirement Plans:** Participation in the CalPERS defined benefit plan, along with voluntary savings options such as 403(b), 401(k), and 457 plans.
* **Educational Benefits:** Tuition fee waiver programs for eligible employees; dependent eligibility varies by employee group and bargaining unit.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.
* **Additional Benefits:** Wellness programs, professional development opportunities, and insurance options including life, disability, and pet insurance.


Candidates are encouraged to review the appropriate CSU Employee Benefits Summary for details specific to their position. Additionally, the CSU Total Compensation Calculator is available to help prospective employees understand the full value of the CSU benefits package and how it complements base salary.



### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**



This position is a student\-focused higher education professional with experience in graduate recruitment, admissions, advising, and program administration. They excel at engaging prospective students through outreach events, presentations, virtual information sessions, and personalized follow\-up, while effectively managing admissions processes through systems such as Salesforce, WebAdmit, and Cal State Apply. They provide comprehensive academic advising, helping students navigate degree requirements, university policies, enrollment, and academic progress, while connecting them to campus resources that support their success.



The ideal candidate is highly organized and collaborative, with the ability to coordinate orientations, student engagement activities, graduation events, and career development initiatives that foster a strong graduate student community. They maintain accurate student records, monitor enrollment trends, assist with course scheduling, and work closely with faculty, administrators, and campus partners to ensure efficient program operations. jobs.title: Event Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Colette’s Catering \& Events is seeking an organized, hospitality\-minded **Sales Coordinator** to support our Director of Sales and Sales Managers throughout the sales and event lifecycle.

This is a junior\-level sales position with a strong administrative focus and an opportunity to develop toward a future Sales Manager role. The Sales Coordinator will assist with lead management, client communication, proposals, event documentation, scheduling, venue coordination, and operational handoffs. Based on experience and demonstrated readiness, this position may also serve as a Day\-of Coordinator for selected events.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to incoming inquiries, collect preliminary event information, maintain lead records, and route opportunities to the appropriate Sales Manager.
* Provide administrative support, including calendar management, client files, correspondence, reporting, and sales materials.
* Prepare proposals, estimates, menus, contracts, presentations, and other documents using approved pricing and templates.
* Coordinate client follow\-up, tastings, site visits, walkthroughs, detail meetings, and rehearsals.
* Maintain accurate event information, including guest counts, menus, dietary needs, rentals, timelines, floor plans, venue requirements, payments, and deadlines.
* Prepare and update BEOs, change orders, function sheets, and supporting documents for Sales Manager review.
* Track missing information and outstanding decisions and support a complete handoff to Operations, Culinary, Warehouse, Accounting, venues, and vendors.
* Maintain venue and vendor records and communicate routine information under the direction of the assigned Sales Manager.
* Participate in Sales meetings, BEO reviews, tastings, and client meetings.
* Escalate pricing exceptions, contract revisions, credits, client concerns, and commitments requiring management approval.
* When assigned as Day\-of Coordinator, support event timelines, vendor arrivals, key transitions, client communication, and event flow in partnership with the Event Captain and culinary leadership.
* Protect confidential client, contract, pricing, payment, employee, and company information.

**Technology Requirements**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, including email, calendars, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and shared drives.
* Experience with CRM, catering, hospitality, or event\-management software preferred; experience with Elecate or a comparable platform is a plus.
* Experience with workforce scheduling systems such as Nowsta and event\-diagramming or floor\-plan software is preferred.
* Ability to maintain organized electronic files, perform accurate data entry, manage document versions, and learn new systems quickly.
* Working spreadsheet skills, including formatting, sorting, filtering, and basic formulas.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; college coursework or a degree in hospitality, event management, business, marketing, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in catering, hospitality, events, sales support, customer service, or office administration preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, accuracy, follow\-through, and ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Professional, gracious, and solutions\-oriented approach to clients and coworkers.
* Ability to work independently within assigned authority and collaborate across departments.
* Availability for assigned evening, weekend, or holiday events.
* Ability to travel locally to company facilities, venues, and event locations.

**Physical and Work Environment Requirements**

The position regularly requires computer and telephone use, sitting, standing, walking, reaching, and communicating verbally and in writing. Event assignments may require extended standing or walking, navigating indoor and outdoor spaces, climbing stairs, bending, and occasionally lifting or moving items weighing up to 25 pounds.

Reasonable accommodations will be considered for qualified applicants and employees to perform the essential functions of the position.

**About Colette’s Catering \& Events**

We create memorable culinary experiences through gracious service, creative cuisine, collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to quality and innovation. Our values are Gracious Service, Collaboration, Passion, Innovation, Integrity, and Creativity. Everything we do supports our Brand Promise: “Total satisfaction for every special occasion.”

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Colette’s Catering \& Events is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Colette’s Catering \& Events is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, as required by law.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 24\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee discount

Ability to Commute:

* Fullerton, CA 92831 (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: ARTIST CONTENT & SOCIAL MEDIA COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
ARTIST CONTENT \& SOCIAL MEDIA COORDINATOR  
Music / Entertainment \- Part\-Time, On\-Site  
Beverly Hills / Los Angeles, CA

THIS IS AN ON\-SITE POSITION \- NOT REMOTE.  
Independent DJ, producer, and recording artist DJSuziQ is seeking a creative, highly organized Artist Content \& Social  
Media Coordinator to work directly with the artist and help manage the day\-to\-day content, social media, and digital  
operations surrounding an active music career and independent record label.  
The right person will regularly be with the artist filming, photographing, editing, and posting content in real time, as well as  
helping coordinate music releases, social platforms, analytics, and artist\-related projects.

SCHEDULE

Approximately Monday\-Friday, 2\-7 PM or 3\-8 PM, depending on the day's schedule. Flexibility is important. Some  
evenings and weekends will be required for performances, content shoots, events, and music releases. Occasional  
domestic and international travel may also be required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content Creation \& Social Media

* Film high\-quality vertical video and take photos of the artist using an iPhone.
* Create engaging content for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
* Edit Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts quickly in CapCut.
* Edit and enhance photos for social media.
* Create Stories, graphics, announcements and other assets in Canva.
* Add captions, music, text, transitions, effects and branding.
* Frequently shoot, edit and publish content the same day \- sometimes within hours.
* Assist with content concepts, locations, trends and shoot planning.
* Maintain an organized content library of photos, videos and finished assets.
* Help maintain a consistent posting schedule and artist brand.
* Monitor comments, engagement and audience response.
* Music \& Artist Operations
* Assist with new music release campaigns and promotional schedules.
* Update and monitor Spotify for Artists, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Beatport and other music platforms.
* Track social and streaming performance and prepare simple weekly reports.
* Coordinate assets and deadlines with label/distribution, marketing, branding, and promotional partners.
* Help organize music, artwork, videos, masters, press materials and release assets.
* Assist with artist/label administrative projects when needed.
* Music\-industry experience involving ASCAP/BMI, publishing, copyrights, metadata, DSPs, or music distribution is a major plus.

REQUIRED SKILLS: Platforms are a plus, but not required. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: You are creative but also organized, dependable, and proactive. You understand that working with an artist isn't a conventional desk job. One afternoon may involve editing content and analyzing social performance; another may involve filming a DJ set, shooting lifestyle content around Los Angeles, or helping prepare for a music release. You should be comfortable taking initiative, working directly with the artist, handling confidential/unreleased material, adapting quickly.

* CapCut \- strong working knowledge required.
* Canva \- required.
* iPhone photography \& videography \- required; strong eye for framing, lighting and vertical 9:16 content.DJSuziQ \- Artist Content \& Social Media Coordinator \| Page 2
* Instagram, TikTok \& YouTube \- required.
* Photo editing \- Lightroom, Photoshop/Photoshop Express, Snapseed or equivalent.
* Google Drive / Dropbox \- comfortable organizing and sharing files.
* Social\-media analytics \- able to understand what content is and isn't performing.
* Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Photoshop, Lightroom, Spotify for Artists or other music\-industry

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 25\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager – Industrial Electrical Services**

**Company:** GRC Industrial, LLC

**Location:** Anaheim, CA — Hybrid, with travel to customer locations for job walks

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary with uncapped performance incentives based on sales and project profitability

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, PTO, vehicle allowance or company vehicle, phone/laptop

**About GRC Industrial**

GRC Industrial, LLC is an industrial electrical contractor serving manufacturing clients across California, Arizona, and Nevada. We deliver electrical construction, facility upgrade, and equipment installation projects for some of the most demanding industrial environments in the region — from process plants to high\-tech manufacturing facilities.

**Our Core Values**

At GRC Industrial, we believe great results come from great teams. We work hard, support each other, take pride in what we do, and want to build a company where people enjoy working together.

We value a team\-first mentality, open communication, collaboration, professionalism, accountability, and respect. We expect our leaders to take ownership, approach challenges constructively, work together toward solutions, value the expertise of both our office and field teams, and bring a positive attitude to work each day.

Success at GRC isn’t just about individual performance — it’s about delivering great results while helping the people around you succeed and building a company we’re all proud to be part of.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Account Manager to grow and manage relationships with industrial manufacturing clients — specifically in the food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace sectors. You’ll be the face of GRC Industrial to plant managers, facility engineers, project managers, and procurement teams, identifying electrical construction and maintenance opportunities and turning them into won work.

This is a hunter\-and\-farmer role: you’ll develop new accounts in our target verticals while deepening relationships with existing clients to capture repeat and negotiated work.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, pursue, and win industrial electrical projects (installations, upgrades, expansions, equipment hookups, controls, and maintenance contracts) with food \& beverage, automotive, and aerospace manufacturers
* Build and maintain relationships with plant engineering, facilities, maintenance, and capital projects teams at target accounts
* Develop a territory plan and pipeline; track opportunities from lead through award
* Partner with our estimating team on scope reviews, walk\-downs, RFIs, and proposal strategy to ensure bids match what the client actually needs
* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site walks; gather field intelligence that sharpens our pricing and win rate
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contract scope in coordination with leadership
* Stay in front of clients through the life of a project — handling change order conversations, resolving issues, and setting up the next opportunity
* Represent GRC Industrial at industry events, trade associations, and networking functions
* Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, and activity reporting

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 3\+ years of B2B sales or account management experience in electrical contracting, industrial construction, MEP services, or a closely related trade
* Working knowledge of industrial electrical systems and construction project delivery (bid/spec, design\-build, negotiated work)
* Proven track record of winning and growing accounts with industrial or manufacturing clients
* Ability to read plans and specs well enough to have credible technical conversations with facility engineers
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites for job walks and client meetings

**Preferred:**

* Existing relationships in food \& beverage, automotive, or aerospace manufacturing
* Field experience as an electrician, electrical PM, or estimator
* Familiarity with safety prequalification systems (ISNetworld, Avetta) and GMP/cleanroom environments
* Experience with CRM software and construction takeoff/estimating workflows

**Why GRC Industrial**

* Established contractor with a strong reputation and repeat industrial client base
* Direct access to leadership — your input shapes which work we chase
* Uncapped earning potential tied to the business you bring in

Pay: $61,647\.43 \- $74,242\.06 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Anaheim, CA 92806

jobs.title: In- House SEO & Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
QUALITY FIRST BUILDERS

Construction company is a growing design\-build and general contracting company specializing in high\-end residential remodeling, additions, ADUs, and new construction throughout the Los Angeles area.

We are looking for an experienced In\-House SEO \& Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of our SEO, website performance, local search presence, paid search campaigns, analytics, and digital lead\-generation strategy.

We currently work with an outside SEO company, but our goal is to bring these capabilities in\-house with someone who can work on our business full\-time, understand our market deeply, and continuously improve our online visibility and lead generation.

This is a hands\-on position. We are not looking for someone whose experience is primarily managing outside agencies. We want someone who can personally execute, analyze, troubleshoot, test, and improve our digital marketing.

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy \& On\-Page SEO

* Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy focused on generating qualified remodeling and construction leads. **Perform keyword research and identify opportunities based on search volume, competition, location, and customer intent.** Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, page structure, images, and website content. **Develop strong internal\-linking strategies.** Identify content gaps and create strategies for service pages, city/location pages, project pages, FAQs, and blog content. **Monitor keyword rankings and organic search performance.** Analyze competitors and identify opportunities to outperform them in local search results.

Technical SEO

* Perform regular technical SEO audits. **Manage crawlability, indexing, XML sitemaps, redirects, canonical tags, robots.txt, and duplicate\-content issues.** Implement and maintain structured data/schema markup. **Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals.** Identify and correct broken links, crawl errors, indexing issues, and other technical SEO problems. **Work directly inside Google Search Console to identify and resolve search\-performance issues.**

Website Development \& Management

* Manage and maintain our WordPress/CMS website. **Create and modify landing pages, service pages, project pages, and location pages.** Strong understanding of HTML and CSS; working knowledge of JavaScript. **Improve website speed, usability, mobile responsiveness, and overall performance.** Understand hosting, DNS, domains, SSL, redirects, backups, and website security basics. **Work with designers/developers when advanced development is required.**

Local SEO \& Google Business Profile

* Take ownership of our Google Business Profile. **Optimize our presence in Google Maps and local search results.** Manage categories, services, photos, posts, Q\&A, reviews, and other GBP features. **Develop strategies to increase legitimate customer reviews.** Build, audit, and maintain local citations and directory listings. **Maintain consistent NAP/business information across the web.**

Link Building \& Off\-Page SEO

* Develop and execute ethical backlink\-building strategies. **Conduct outreach for relevant links, guest posts, partnerships, mentions, and digital PR opportunities.** Evaluate backlink quality and monitor our backlink profile. **Identify competitor backlink opportunities.** Build relationships with relevant local websites, publications, organizations, suppliers, and industry resources.

Google Ads \& Paid Search

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, remarketing, and other relevant campaign types. **Help manage and optimize Local Services Ads where applicable.** Perform keyword research, negative\-keyword management, bid optimization, ad testing, and landing\-page optimization. **Continuously monitor cost per lead, conversion rate, lead quality, and return on advertising spend.** Identify wasted spend and opportunities to improve campaign profitability.

Analytics, Tracking \& Reporting

* Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and conversion tracking. **Properly track phone calls, contact forms, booked appointments, and other important conversion events.** Build dashboards and reports covering organic traffic and rankings, leads by source, cost per lead, conversion rates, Google Ads performance, local/Google Maps performance, website performance, lead quality, and ROI. **Go beyond reporting numbers—we expect this person to explain what is working, what isn't, why, and what we should do next.**

Content \& Copywriting

* Write and optimize website copy that is both SEO\-friendly and persuasive. **Create or help develop service pages, landing pages, project descriptions, FAQs, blog articles, and location\-specific content.** Understand search intent and how to create content designed to rank while converting visitors into leads. **Use AI tools effectively while maintaining original, useful, brand\-appropriate content.**

Reddit, Forums \& Community Marketing

* Understand Reddit culture, subreddit rules, and proper community engagement. **Identify opportunities to build organic brand visibility without spam or overly promotional posting.** Participate strategically in relevant construction, remodeling, homeowner, and local communities. **Identify additional forums, Q\&A sites, Facebook/community groups, and online communities where our target customers are active.**

CRM, Lead Funnel \& Automation

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
**About Nines Media**

Nines Media is the media and marketing division of Nines Group, a business solutions company focused on helping brands grow throughout the United States.

Our team works with restaurant franchises, beauty and skincare brands, lifestyle products, and consumer focused businesses through social media marketing, content creation, influencer partnerships, digital campaigns, retail activations, and experiential marketing.

Many of the brands we work with are connected to Korean food, beauty, entertainment, and lifestyle culture, while also working with a diverse range of brands across different industries.

As our influencer and creator network continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help build strong relationships with creators and manage collaborations from beginning to end.

**Position Overview**

Nines Media is seeking a full time Influencer Marketing Associate to manage influencer relationships and support creator campaigns across multiple brands.

This position will be responsible for identifying and communicating with influencers, developing collaboration concepts, preparing campaign briefs, coordinating agreements, and managing projects through completion.

The role involves working directly with influencers and creators while also coordinating internally with the marketing and content teams to make sure each collaboration is properly planned and executed.

The ideal candidate is organized, communicative, creative, and comfortable working with many different people. Since we work with multiple brands and campaigns at the same time, the ability to manage several projects, keep track of details, and follow up consistently is important.

**Influencer \& Creator Management**

* Research and identify influencers and creators that align with each brand and campaign
* Reach out to influencers and manage initial communications
* Build and maintain ongoing relationships with influencers and creators
* Discuss collaboration opportunities, deliverables, timelines, and campaign requirements
* Develop and finalize content concepts with influencers
* Prepare campaign briefs, creative guidelines, and project information
* Coordinate contracts, agreements, and other campaign documentation
* Track influencer deliverables, deadlines, and posting schedules
* Follow up with creators throughout the campaign to ensure projects stay on track
* Review submitted content and coordinate revisions when necessary
* Maintain organized records of influencer contacts, campaigns, and project results

**Internal Influencer Management**

Nines Media also works with an internal network of influencers and creators who participate in ongoing brand campaigns.

Responsibilities will include:

* Coordinate schedules and projects for internal influencers
* Match internal influencers with appropriate brand campaigns
* Communicate campaign concepts, expectations, and deliverables
* Help plan and organize filming schedules and content production
* Track completed content and campaign deliverables
* Work with the internal team to develop new opportunities for our influencer network

**Content \& Marketing Support**

While influencer management will be the primary focus of this position, the role will also support broader content marketing initiatives.

* Assist with content planning and campaign preparation
* Research social media trends and emerging creator trends
* Support short form video and photo content production
* Assist with social media content when needed
* Participate in brand events, pop ups, and influencer activations
* Collaborate with the marketing team on campaigns and promotional initiatives

**Candidate Qualifications**

* Strong interest in influencer marketing, social media, digital media, and creator culture
* Strong communication and relationship building skills
* Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Ability to manage multiple influencers and projects simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail and follow through
* Comfortable communicating professionally through email, messaging platforms, and calls
* Creative mindset with an understanding of social media content
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with a larger team
* Professional, reliable, and proactive

Experience in influencer marketing, social media marketing, content creation, public relations, brand marketing, talent management, or a related field is preferred.

Experience with social media platforms, influencer platforms, spreadsheets, project management tools, or content creation software is a plus.

An interest in Korean food, beauty, entertainment, fashion, and lifestyle culture is also a plus, as many of the brands and creators we work with are connected to Korean culture.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role is designed for individuals seeking long term growth in influencer marketing, brand partnerships, and digital media.

Strong performers will have opportunities to manage larger campaigns, develop relationships with higher profile creators, take greater ownership of brand partnerships, and contribute to the growth of Nines Media's influencer network.

**Additional Opportunities**

* Work directly with influencers, creators, and brand partners
* Participate in influencer events, pop ups, and brand activations
* Opportunities to attend industry events and creator campaigns
* Occasional domestic and international travel opportunities based on project needs and performance
* Opportunities to participate in content production and appear on camera are available but not required

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Employee Discounts
* Professional Development Assistance
* Career Growth Opportunities

**Work Location:** In Person

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $23\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Social Media Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Nines Media is a social media marketing firm specializing in brand focused digital campaigns across major platforms. We work closely with restaurant franchises, beauty and skincare brands, lifestyle products, and consumer focused businesses to build long term brand presence through strategic content, short form video, and experiential marketing.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help turn Casco's founder\-led sales momentum into a repeatable outbound engine. You'll start conversations with AppSec leaders and CISOs who know annual pentests and noisy security scanners cannot keep up with how quickly modern teams ship software. Your job is to make the problem urgent, earn the right to a deeper conversation, and create qualified pipeline for Casco's autonomous security testing platform.


This is not a role where you inherit a perfect script and spend all day blasting sequences. You'll work in person with our founders and sales team in San Francisco, learn how technical security buyers think, test messages in the market, and help build the outbound playbook as Casco scales after its Series A.

**What You'll Actually Do**
---------------------------

* **Create qualified pipeline:** Research target accounts, identify the right AppSec and security leaders, and turn cold accounts into real sales conversations.
* **Write outbound that sounds human:** Build sharp, account\-specific messaging across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other channels instead of hiding behind generic sequences.
* **Learn the security problem:** Understand how companies buy pentests today, where point\-in\-time testing falls short, and why continuous autonomous testing matters.
* **Qualify for substance:** Find a credible security problem, relevant use case, buying context, and concrete next step before handing an opportunity to an Account Executive.
* **Work events:** Attend security events with the team, start conversations in the room, and follow up fast enough to turn interest into pipeline.
* **Build the playbook:** Test personas, industries, hooks, objections, and channels, then document what works so we can repeat it.
* **Keep the CRM honest:** Record the source, account, persona, meeting outcome, and next step so the team can trust the pipeline and improve the motion.
* **Close the feedback loop:** Share what prospects say with founders, sales, engineering, and security so we keep sharpening the product and the story.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must\-Haves**

* At least one year of outbound SDR or BDR experience in B2B software, with evidence that you can consistently create qualified meetings.
* Strong writing and research skills. You can find a real reason to contact an account and explain it without corporate filler.
* Comfort on the phone. You can open a cold conversation, ask a useful question, listen, and earn a next step.
* The curiosity to learn application security, pentesting, vulnerabilities, cloud environments, APIs, and how technical buyers evaluate new security products.
* Good judgment about quality. You would rather create the right meeting than hit a vanity activity number.
* Resilience and follow\-through. You can handle rejection, keep your standards high, and stay organized across a large account set.
* Startup readiness. You are comfortable testing ideas, working without a finished playbook, and making your own progress visible.
* The ability to work in person from our San Francisco office.

### **Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience prospecting into cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, or another technical category.
* Familiarity with AppSec leaders, security engineers, CISOs, or the pentesting market.
* Experience at an early\-stage startup or helping create a new outbound motion.
* A genuine interest in how attackers think and how AI is changing offensive security.

**Your First Three Months**
---------------------------


You'll have a three\-month ramp to learn Casco, our buyers, and the outbound motion before carrying a full quota.

* **Month 1 — 25% quota:** Learn the product and market, build account lists, practice the story, and begin live prospecting.
* **Month 2 — 50% quota:** Run consistent outbound, handle common objections, and create your first accepted opportunities.
* **Month 3 — 75% quota:** Own a defined account set and build a repeatable weekly pipeline rhythm.
* **Month 4 onward — 100% quota:** Carry the full monthly target.


During the three\-month ramp, you'll receive guaranteed variable compensation while you build toward full productivity.

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------

* This is not a remote role. You will build the motion alongside the team in our San Francisco office.
* This is not an activity contest where a dashboard full of calls matters more than whether anyone should take the meeting.
* This is not a mature sales organization with a finished script, perfect data, and every objection already documented.
* This is not a role for someone who wants to sell a checkbox. You will need to explain why a new approach to security testing should exist.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **San Francisco based:** Work in person with our founders, sales team, engineers, and security experts.
* **Compensation:**


	+ Base salary: $80,000
	+ Target variable: $40,000
	+ On\-target earnings: $120,000
	+ Equity grant with meaningful ownership in Casco
* **Real ownership:** Help build the outbound motion for a new category instead of inheriting someone else's playbook.
* **Direct access:** Learn alongside founders and technical teammates who can answer hard questions and act quickly on market feedback.
* **A product with proof:** Casco has already found critical vulnerabilities across 300\+ companies despite their existing security tools and human pentesters.
* **Learning opportunities:** We support your growth with a budget for conferences, books, courses, and the tools that help you improve.

**Our Mission**
---------------


Casco's mission is to make all software effortlessly secure. We build AI agents that think like attackers and give security teams solutions instead of another pile of noisy alerts.


The time it takes attackers to weaponize vulnerabilities is collapsing, while companies are shipping more software than eve

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.


**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities

* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience including completion of the Sysco Sales Internship.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sell something local business owners actually want: a phone that rings.

Look Good Online builds websites and runs local marketing, Google visibility, reviews, call tracking, for small service businesses across Georgia and Texas: plumbers, roofers, HVAC companies, dentists, contractors. Most of them already know their website is dead or they can't be found on Google. You're not creating a problem to sell against, you're offering the fix to one they already have. You reach out, show them what we do, and close them onto a monthly plan. Our production team builds and manages everything after that — you never touch a website.

How you get paid

Every client pays you in real dollars, not vague percentages:

The Sketch ($350/mo plan): $105 up front, then $52\.50 every month the client stays.

The Masterpiece ($850/mo plan): $255 up front, then $127\.50 every month the client stays.

The Gallery ($1,900/mo plan): $570 up front, then $285 every month the client stays.

Simple Sites ($100–$200/mo plans): $15–$30 up front, then $10–$20 every month the client stays.

That second number is the one that matters. It lands every month the client stays, whether you sell anything new that month or not. Ten Masterpiece clients on your book is $1,275 a month showing up on its own. Thirty is $3,825\.

Closing a steady 2–3 accounts a month, your recurring income alone is on track to run over $4,000/month by month twelve, and it keeps compounding from there because nothing you sold stops paying just because the month ended.

Stay five years, keep it forever. At the five\-year mark your recurring commission vests permanently. You keep collecting on every client you ever brought in, for as long as they keep paying, even if you've moved on to something else entirely.

No hours, no schedule, nobody tracking your time. This isn't a call\-center job. No minimum hours, no shift, no time\-tracking software. We don't care when or where you work. We care whether you close deals.

What you'll do: find local businesses in GA/TX that need help, reach out however closes deals for you, walk owners through our plans, and keep a simple log of who you talked to (that's your proof of the sale — it protects your commission).

What we give you: a full call script and objection\-handling playbook, real live client sites to point to, a checkout link and e\-signature so closing takes minutes, and a production team so you're never on the hook for anything technical.

Who we're looking for: comfortable calling a business owner cold, can hear "no" ten times and make the eleventh call, organized enough to keep a log current, 18\+ and authorized to work in the US as an independent contractor. Sales experience helps, it's not required.

Pay: $34,000\.00 \- $127,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Referral program

Work Location: In person
